subject: Community Preservation Plan Update
overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee reviewed draft updates to its annual plan, set application timelines, and voted on FY23 funding allocation percentages. The committee approved allocating 20% of projected revenues to affordable housing and 10% each to open space and historic preservation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee unanimously approved the meeting minutes for March 8 and April 12, 2022.

items.title: Annual Community Preservation Plan Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed section updates to the draft Community Preservation Plan and agreed to open the application window in early June ahead of formal plan adoption.

items.title: FY23 Budget Recommendation
items.summary: The committee voted to allocate projected FY23 revenue at 20% for affordable housing, 10% each for open space and historic preservation, 5% for administration, and 55% for general reserves.

items.title: Other Business and Committee Calendar
items.summary: Chair Roberta Cameron reviewed the annual committee work plan and schedule, while staff provided updates on a committee vacancy advertisement and curb marker installation.
